name: Disc-o-Matic
description: Disc-o-Matic: a disc-ripping appliance with a web UI. Insert a disc and it is read and recognised: Blu-ray, UHD, DVD and HD DVD are backed up whole or ripped to MKV with MakeMKV (movies, TV season discs, concerts; Plex/Jellyfin naming); audio CDs are read with cdparanoia, checked against AccurateRip and CTDB, tagged from MusicBrainz and saved as FLAC, MP3 or Opus with cover art; data discs are copied as ISO images. Optional automatic jobs with a countdown, live progress, history with logs. Nothing is overwritten without asking.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Database (dom.db), job logs, MakeMKV settings and downloaded data. Optional dom.yaml for settings.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Default home of all output: Bluray/ and DVD/ (full backups), MKV/, TV/, Concerts/, Music/ (CDs), CD Images/, ISO/ (data discs). Each can be moved elsewhere in Settings → Storage (map that folder here first, e.g. /mnt/user/Music → /music). Use a /mnt/user/... path: the mover leaves it alone (a /mnt/cache/... folder is moved away by the mover).

ports.name: Web UI port
ports.description: Web UI, REST API and live updates: the port on the server (the app listens on 8088 inside the container).

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the app runs as (100 = users). The drive's own groups are added automatically.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permissions of new backups and rips: 000 (rw for everyone, Unraid's own convention) lets SMB users rename and delete them; 002 keeps them from others; 022 read-only for all but the app.

devices.name: Optical drive
devices.description: Block device of the optical drive.

devices.name: Optical drive (SCSI generic)
devices.description: SCSI generic device of the same drive (MakeMKV talks to the drive through it). The number can change when disks are added; see Requires for how to find it.
